name: Stablemaster
about: Feeds whatever you have talked into following you.
greetings: I have seen worse come through here. Not many.
Feed it or it leaves. That is the whole of the art.
gossip: Hurt it first and feed it second. Nobody likes that advice and it works.
A full beast fights. A hungry one watches.
Three is as many as anyone can keep track of, whatever they tell you.
